ExternalIdentifier.description: Identifier of the enterprise from external system.

HoldingKey.description: Identifies an enterprise in the external system of a holding company. The holding company may administer multiple portfolios.

ChainId.description: Unique identifier of the chain to which the enterprise belongs.

ChainName.description: Name of the `Chain` to which the enterprise belongs.

CreatedUtc.description: Creation date and time of the enterprise in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

UpdatedUtc.description: Last update date and time of the enterprise in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

ShortName.description: Short name of the enterprise used in Manager Report exports.

TimeZoneIdentifier.description: IANA timezone identifier of the enterprise.

LegalEnvironmentCode.description: Unique identifier of the legal environment where the enterprise resides.

AccommodationEnvironmentCode.description: Unique code of the accommodation environment where the enterprise resides.

AccountingEnvironmentCode.description: Unique code of the accounting environment where the enterprise resides.

TaxEnvironmentCode.description: Unique code of the tax environment where the enterprise resides.

DefaultLanguageCode.description: Language-culture codes of the enterprise default `Language`.

AccountingEditableHistoryInterval.description: Editable history interval for accounting data in ISO 8601 duration format.

OperationalEditableHistoryInterval.description: Editable history interval for operational data in ISO 8601 duration format.

BusinessDayClosingOffset.description: The offset value for the business day closing time, in ISO 8601 duration format.

LogoImageId.description: Unique identifier of the `Image` of the enterprise logo.

CoverImageId.description: Unique identifier of the `Image` of the enterprise cover.

Pricing.title: Pricing
Pricing.description:
Pricing of the enterprise.

Gross (The enterprise shows amount with gross prices.)

Net (The enterprise shows amount with net prices.)
x-enumDescriptions: The enterprise shows amount with gross prices.
The enterprise shows amount with net prices.

TaxPrecision.description: Tax precision used for financial calculations in the enterprise. If `null`, `Currency` precision is used.

AddressId.description: Unique identifier of the `Address` of the enterprise.

GroupNames.description: A list of the group names of the enterprise.

LinkedUtc.description: Date and time when enterprise was added to the portfolio in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.
